role: Root tab container (Dashboard / Record / Fitness / Flo / More): owns the dashboard's 35-session slice, per-tab NavigationPaths reset on every tab selection, the dashboard toolbar (notifications, Send report menu, Ask Flo menu), the report mail/share sheets and the recovery-detail sheet; reacts to archive changes, CloudKit pulls, foreground, settings toggles and assistant open requests.
types: MainTabView: struct (View) — app root tabs and dashboard data owner
MainTabView.SendReportKind: enum — recovery | daily | workout send-report menu items
MainTabView.Tab: enum — tab ids incl. retired assistant/history/trends/settings cases kept for deep links
MainTabView.AskFloPrompt: private struct — title/icon/prompt for the Ask Flo menu
DashboardLoadTiming: struct — timestamps of one dashboard reload for slow-load logging
state: @State selectedTab, dashboardPath/recordPath/fitnessPath/coachPath/morePath, sessions, totalSessionCount, seedScore, seedSummary, selectedReportSession, refreshTask, lastDashboardReloadAt, dashboardReloadInFlight/Pending/Deferred, scrollToTopToken, preparingReportKind, pendingReportMailURL, reportPrepError (all view-local)
toplevel: Environment: dependencies, RRCollector, ArchiveSignal, LanguageManager, CloudKitSyncManager, scenePhase. #Preview builds MainTabView() with a fresh RRCollector and the shared CloudKitSyncManager/LanguageManager.
